name: rbi_get_policy_rate
description:
Reserve Bank of India policy rates and reserve ratios in percent: repo rate, reverse repo rate, bank rate, cash reserve ratio (CRR) or statutory liquidity ratio (SLR), from the Reserve Bank of India's DBIE endpoint (rbi.org.in/Scripts/api/dbie, no API key).
Returns: series_code, label, description, unit, frequency, observation_count and observations (date, value) as the endpoint orders them.
Inputs (* required): rate_type* (repo_rate, reverse_repo_rate, bank_rate, crr, slr; schema default repo_rate); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, passed through as fromDate and toDate); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For government bond yields use rbi_get_gsec_yield; for inflation rbi_get_inflation.
Example: {"rate_type": "repo_rate", "start_date": "2022-01-01", "end_date": "2024-12-31"}
